_comment: VS Code / GitHub Copilot agent-mode MCP configuration. Workspace scope: .vscode/mcp.json (committable, recommended so the team shares it). User profile scope: run the 'MCP: Open User Configuration' command and paste the same 'servers' block. NOTE THE DIFFERENCE: VS Code uses the top-level key 'servers', NOT 'mcpServers', and requires 'type': 'stdio' on local servers. A config copied from Claude Desktop will be silently ignored here.

catalogue._comment_cwd: Optional. Defaults to the workspace folder. Set it explicitly if your paths are relative to somewhere else.

catalogue-http._comment: Streamable HTTP. VS Code also accepts 'sse' and 'ws' here. ${input:...} prompts once and stores the value, so the token never lands in this file. The matching 'inputs' array is at the bottom of this file.

inputs.description: Bearer token for the catalogue MCP server
